description: A Model Weather picture's value at a point, from the four pixels flow_cell gives (each its red, green and alpha bytes): read between them linearly, as weatherlayers-gl's LINEAR reading does, each byte a 255th of `unscale` [least, most] a step. For the wind (`vector`) its east part in red and north part in green are each read so, and its speed and the direction it blows from (degrees true, null for a calm) come from those parts, the vector average, so the same point reads the same wind on every app. Null where a pixel the point is read from has no value (alpha 0).

pixels.description: Four pixels, as flow_cell orders them, each [red, green, alpha] bytes.
